page_summary: This page presents Figure 17, which illustrates the distribution of survey respondents by organizational type in the context of cybersecurity in ports. The figure categorizes respondents into five groups: Port association, Ministry, Other, Terminal operator, and Port authority, with the largest segment being Port association at 56%. The page also discusses limitations of the survey findings, emphasizing potential biases and the representativeness of the data.

regions.label: Figure 17
regions.description: A pie chart showing the percentage distribution of survey respondents by organizational type: Port association (56%), Terminal operator (17.4%), Other (14.7%), Ministry (7.3%), and Port authority (4.6%).
